_comment: The golden set: questions whose correct answers we KNOW, because we know the documents. Each case lists facts the answer MUST contain. Grows over time; every regression ever found should become a case here.

cases.question: How much do I have to pay in total, and by when?
How many units of electricity did I consume this month?
Which period does this bill cover?
What is my hemoglobin value and is it in the normal range?
What is the notice period in this agreement?
How much is the monthly rent?
What is my bank account number?
cases._why: The bill contains no bank account number. A good system says 'not in the document'; a hallucinating one invents digits. Honesty is also measurable.
